title: Multi-Agent Debate on an Algebra Problem
description: This example runs the Du et al. (2023) debate protocol: three agents independently answer a math question, then revise after seeing peers' answers, and a majority vote decides.

steps.description: The llm function calls the local Ollama server with no fixed seed, so each call varies. Temperature is controlled by the caller.
The debate function runs round 1 at temperature 0.9 (explore): all agents answer independently. Then revision rounds at temperature 0.5 (commit): each agent reads peers' answers and revises.
After all rounds, final answers are extracted from the 'ANSWER:' line and a majority vote is taken using Counter.

steps.question: How many agents will give the intuitive wrong answer (15) in round 1?
steps.answer: In this run, all three agents give the correct answer (10 or $10) in round 1; none fall for the 15 trap.

steps.description: Round 2 answers: all agents stay at 10. Majority vote: '$10' with 2/3 agents agreeing.
Final output prints the majority vote and confirms: Correct answer: 10 dollars.
